description: Loads the page healthy, then fails one GET endpoint with each fault kind and checks that the ready marker comes back: by itself (recovery "automatic") or after clicking retrySelector ("retry"). Returns an outcome per fault, why the healthy baseline failed if it did, the text the screen showed under a fault it did not recover from, and the report folder, which includes fix-brief.md and reproduce.mjs.

endpoint.description: Origin and path of the GET read to fail, as find_page_reads lists it.

faults.description: Which faults to apply; all of http-error, connection-failure, invalid-json by default.

readySelector.description: CSS selector of the one element that is visible only once that read has rendered its data. It must match exactly one element: for a list, choose its container or a single item, not a selector every item matches.

readyText.description: Text the ready element must contain.

times.description: How many consecutive requests each fault fails.

url.description: Page of a development or test app.

name: check_read_recovery
title: Check that a page recovers when a read fails
